Bitdeer Technologies.why: converts its ~3 GW powered-land portfolio into AI data-center capacity: a 16-year, ~$4.7 billion colocation lease at Tydal, Norway (121 IT MW for NVIDIA GPUs) and its own Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 / Vera Rubin) - its revenue grows directly with AI compute build-out
Bitdeer Technologies.evidence: Bitdeer Technologies Q2 FY2026 (08-10-2026), CSO Haris Basit: subsidiary Tydal Data Center AS executed a 16-year colocation lease and services agreement with Volta at the Tydal campus, delivering 121 IT MW configured to run NVIDIA GPUs, approximately $4.7 billion in contracted base-term revenue

players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer AI Further Expands AI Cloud Services with Off-take (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bitdeer AI secured off-take commitments of more than 70% of the approximately 21.7MW A201 AI Cloud facility in Johor Bahru, Malaysia ahead of energization in Q1 2027, contracting more than $1.7 billion of expected revenue over the next 5 years; total expected revenue backlog is now approximately $2.9 billion. A201 is a liquid-cooled facility purpose-built for rack-scale NVIDIA GB300 NVL72, with part of its rack space designed for NVIDIA's next-generation Vera Rubin; Bitdeer AI has procured more than 100 racks of NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems ahead of energization from an unaffiliated third-party supplier. Active pipeline for AI cloud capacity exceeds $10 billion; target remains up to 350MW of AI Cloud capacity by the first quarter of 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: >70% of 21.7MW A201 contracted; >$1.7 billion over 5 years; backlog ~$2.9 billion; pipeline >$10 billion
